title: Non-invasive Heart Failure Monitoring Using Novel Acceleration Sensors System
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to explore the feasibility of monitoring hemodynamic changes, which result from heart failure exacerbations, by recording the respiratory effort, chest wall dynamics and quantifying the development of dyspnea by using miniature mechanical sensors that are attaches to the chest.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Acute decompensated HF
* Decompensated chronic HF in patients with NYHA class III-IV symptoms
* Age over 20 years
* Ejection fraction reduced below 35% OR doppler evidence of impaired left ventricular diastolic filling

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability or unwillingness to follow the study protocol
